about: The judge's step 2 on the production site on Monad mainnet (scripts/live-judge-agent.mjs): /judge asks the reference agent from the page to write to an address with a key; no passkey is made or used. Each run spends one of the agent's drops.

runs.error: the agent saw the app's origin
runs.diagnosis: The page's POST reached the agent and the drop landed (dropTx, block 108,572,093); the run then stopped at its own check of the request's Origin header, which read null: Playwright's request.headers() leaves Origin out, and allHeaders() carries it. The agent's own log of the request (Vercel runtime log, deployment dpl_5BaqRCSyZ1urkdzjwYhHvnLUuUxU, 2026-09-27 21:26:23 UTC) shows OPTIONS /remember 204, the preflight it answers only for an allowed origin, then POST /remember 200 with this transaction and 396 bytes. The script now reads allHeaders(); the drop was checked afterwards without sending another (the next run, verifiedOnly).
